subject: reasoning
question: Each of the digits in the number 8912346 is arranged in ascending order from left to right. What will be the sum of the digits that are second from the left and second from the right in the new number thus formed?
solution:
Given number 8912346

Ascending order from left to right.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c5ef5632b6374c6c14daef731f5b6b409d3101797858aca7982014ba524c2c25.png] 

Sum of the digits that are second from the left and second from the right in the new number = 8 + 2 = 10 .
